sources.title: DLD normalized Wraith and Helvetia Marine individual residential sales, 10 October export

facts.identityBasis: Unique non-archived Binghatti Wraith / Binghatti catalogue record, corroborated by its retained primary developer page. DLD public project status names project 4482, legal developer number 1051 and Al Jadaf; the downloadable developer register independently confirms developer ID 15782130. Only Residential/Unit/Flat sale registrations with exact project number, area ID 334, project name and building name Binghatti Wraith are included. Commercial, land, gifts and mortgages are excluded. Generic DLD map coordinates are not used.

observation.observationDateBasis: DLD instance_date registration day; not first-ever sale, contract execution or current valuation
